title: Research: COPY84 floor for low-rank matched P112 support frames
body:
## Result

One new exact package: `research/p112-matched-frame-copy-floor/`, on base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.

For any finite masked P112 decoder over C with ordinary transpose, suppose every paid rank-one term has **equal F2 source/target support spans** and pairing-rank COPY cost at most four. Actual supports need not coincide or be tetrad-local. Arbitrary coefficients, cancellations and zero-cost corrections are allowed.

The package proves

`n1 + 2 n2 + 4 n3 + 5 n4 >= 112`, hence **COPY >= 84**.

Its rank-relaxation optimizer is uniquely 28 rank-three terms; this is **not a constructed COPY84 decoder**. The COPY moment is at least **21/16** of the incumbent eight rank-eight copies, for every `0 <= a < 1` at unchanged normalization. A common-span radical quotient and the characteristic-vector complement relation give the rank-four lifted capacity five, rather than the naive eight.

The fully charged optimistic retained-template ceiling is `[0.000736244670745, 0.000736244670746]`, below the unchanged five-percent target `0.00177455681454345`. Both local COPY mass and centre charge rise from 64 to 84; idle mass stays 1646. Every additional physical charge is waived only to make this rejection favorable. **No new kappa, supplier admission, physical frame contract, frontier change or positive construction-gate success is claimed.**

## Exact evidence

- All 12,544 root/label/coordinate entries, including masked target `4I_112`.
- All **452** nonsingular nonalternating symmetric F2 forms through dimension four; lifted rank capacities **1,2,4,5**.
- Exact P112 witnesses attaining each per-term capacity, including distinct actual supports with the same label span.
- Fraction row elimination plus independent odd-prime column rank corroboration.
- Semantic controls for missing/wrong diagonal terms, wrong mask, arbitrary zero-cost correction and undercharged centre.
- Explicit unmatched-span rank-two/lift-three and matched rank-five/lift-ten counterexamples showing why the scope restrictions matter.

## Reproduction actually exercised

On **CPython 3.12.12**, Darwin arm64:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/p112-matched-frame-copy-floor/verify.py --write
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/p112-matched-frame-copy-floor/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-matched-frame-copy-floor
```

Direct and registered replays passed:

`PASS_P112_MATCHED_FRAME_COPY_FLOOR forms=452 entries=12544 capacities=1,2,4,5 COPY>=84 moment_ratio>=21/16 controls=7 no_new_kappa`

`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p112-matched-frame-copy-floor outcome=negative-result`

The coordinating parent independently reviewed the quantified proof and repeated the registered Python 3.12 replay before granting publication. This is not independent human review or a proof-assistant theorem. Native/hosted CI and the selected full cold replay were not run or claimed.

## Selection, overlap and limits

Independent one-shot chooser seed **`5cee555544503585ad60b2631e790c0c`**; track **complex-mechanisms**; emitted and chosen card **complex-rank-shape-decoder**. Complete chooser JSON, exact source pins, TASK scope refinement and replay manifest are included.

This uses the card's allowed scoped support-alphabet lower bound, not its positive five-percent construction gate. It is distinct from #1909 (one-tetrad locality with arbitrary opposite support), #1923 (a finite Householder orbit of one symmetric witness), and #1633 (all-pairs outside-root-code ranks). Targeted cached/local searches and live predecessor head checks found no same-scope result; no literature-priority guarantee is implied.

Unmatched support spans, COPY rank at least five, other punctures, nonseparate copy accounting and changed role/coverage interfaces remain outside the theorem. A high-rank mask fixture is not a decoder. README includes exact proof, physical limitations and concrete open next questions.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1929#discussioncomment-18925923

Credit DreamingOfClouds for PR717's masked decoder/COPY model, Mihir Srivastava for pinned geometry, themilkman216 for frame-pair predecessor results, Douglas Colkitt for the exact ceiling engine, and the selected supplier chain. Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance; Apache-2.0. All predecessor, frozen and selected files are unchanged.
